pure-announcement.rationale: Reference or research material, not an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: No retrieval-evaluation history exists in the corpus; golden-dataset-retrieval-evals is the practice, not the origin.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Published, cited material; claims checkable at the linked source.

durability.rationale: The founding paradigm of retrieval evaluation — fixed collection, queries, relevance judgments — plus the historically load-bearing detail that expert judges rejected 30%+ of each other's relevance calls.

actionability.rationale: History and paradigm, not procedure; its value is as the model every later eval (TREC, ours) instantiates.

atomicity.rationale: One subject: the experiments and the paradigm they created.
